_source: Trimmed from Google's Discovery document androidmanagement v1, revision 20261014: only the methods the curated tools call (androidmanagement.enterprises.applications.get, androidmanagement.enterprises.devices.get, androidmanagement.enterprises.devices.list, androidmanagement.enterprises.get, androidmanagement.enterprises.list, androidmanagement.enterprises.policies.get, androidmanagement.enterprises.policies.list, androidmanagement.enterprises.webApps.get, androidmanagement.enterprises.webApps.list) and the schemas their request bodies reach. For tests/curated-contract.test.mjs; androidmanagement v1 is a gateway API of gplay (no per-method tools), so data/discovery has no snapshot of it.
name: androidmanagement
title: Android Management API

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the enterprise in the form enterprises/{enterpriseId}.

list.description: Lists EMM-managed enterprises. Only BASIC fields are returned.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A token identifying a page of results returned by the server.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specifies which Enterprise fields to return. This method only supports BASIC.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Required. The Cloud project ID of the EMM managing the enterprises.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The requested page size. The actual page size may be fixed to a min or max value.

list.description: Lists web apps for a given enterprise.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A token identifying a page of results returned by the server.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The requested page size. This is a hint and the actual page size in the response may be different.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: The name of the enterprise in the form enterprises/{enterpriseId}.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the web app in the form enterprises/{enterpriseId}/webApps/{packageName}.

get.description: Gets a device. Deleted devices will respond with a 404 error.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the device in the form enterprises/{enterpriseId}/devices/{deviceId}.

list.description: Lists devices for a given enterprise. Deleted devices are not returned in the response.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A token identifying a page of results returned by the server.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: The name of the enterprise in the form enterprises/{enterpriseId}.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The requested page size. If unspecified, at most 10 devices will be returned. The maximum value is 100; values above 100 will be coerced to 100. The limits can change over time.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the application in the form enterprises/{enterpriseId}/applications/{package_name}.

parameters.name: languageCode
parameters.description: The preferred language for localized application info, as a BCP47 tag (e.g. "en-US", "de"). If not specified the default language of the application will be used.

list.description: Lists policies for a given enterprise.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: The name of the enterprise in the form enterprises/{enterpriseId}.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The requested page size. The actual page size may be fixed to a min or max value.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A token identifying a page of results returned by the server.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the policy in the form enterprises/{enterpriseId}/policies/{policyId}.
